The Poisoned Well of Thornwick (invented for DMbot's tests; every name here is made up)

Thornwick is a farming village on the Dun river. Its people draw their water from the Old Well in the square. Three days ago the Old Well was poisoned, and half the village fell sick.

The village is asking one question: who poisoned the Old Well of Thornwick?

Brother Aldo keeps the village shrine. Mira Vell is the village herbalist and sells remedies from her cottage. Captain Rusk leads the village watch. Oswin the miller runs the mill on the Dun river, upstream of the square.

Four travellers have come to Thornwick: Cerric Vanya'elen, Belleros Stormgrace, Okthandom Korran and Claude Ambere. Elder Hobb, who speaks for the village, asked them to find who poisoned the Old Well.
